projects.name: TripFlow
projects.text: A corporate travel API built around three production problems: concurrent approvals competing for the same budget, booking retries, and failures between the database and the broker.
projects.stack: PHP 8.3 · Laravel 12 · MySQL · Redis · RabbitMQ · Docker · Pest · Larastan
bullets: SELECT … FOR UPDATE on the cost center keeps two approvals from spending the same balance; a test with two MySQL connections proves the approval waits for the lock.

Idempotency-Key replays the saved response for retries; during booking, a Redis lock serializes booking and cancellation, and bookings already confirmed are compensated at the supplier when another part fails.
A transactional outbox publishes to RabbitMQ after commit with publisher confirms; the consumer deduplicates redeliveries through an inbox. Company scoping and tenant-isolation tests.

projects.name: GEMP
projects.text: A fictional credit comparison tool that queries three providers in parallel and compares total cost, showing what the UI can still deliver when a provider is slow or down.
projects.stack: Go · net/http · WebAssembly · React · TypeScript · Vite · GitHub Actions
bullets: Each provider runs in a goroutine with context.Context and its own 250 ms deadline; partial results when one fails, 503 with no offers, and a panicking provider becomes an isolated failure.
The public demo runs the same Go code compiled to WebAssembly in the browser, verified in CI against the API's scenarios.
